name: AspectRatio1610
description: Native 16:10 fullscreen support for 16:10 monitors, laptops, and handhelds (Steam Deck, 1280x800, 1920x1200, 2560x1600). Full-screen gameplay and shop without black bars, with top-anchored HUD and clean 16:9 letterbox menus.

godot.description_rich:
Native 16:10 Fullscreen for all 16:10 screens (1280x800, 1920x1200, 2560x1600, Steam Deck, etc.):
- 100% full-screen gameplay, shop, and end-run screens without black bars
- HUD anchored directly to the top edge of the 16:10 screen
- Menus stay centered and proportionate in 16:9 letterbox without distorted 2D artwork
- Automatically applies borderless fullscreen at native screen resolution
- Fixes the vanilla Fullscreen toggle button in Options
- Zero external dependencies
